description:
## Problem
Two comments on #4381 (2026-11-19 13:17Z and 16:45Z) say "The owner named this PR and head". The record: the owner submitted the dialog value `4381@f734774ad5f38b3b65841df61760709c2c87f51f` from an option the agent wrote, and approved the second head the same way. The second comment also says the head was re-authored "because develop requires extra approval for commits not linked to a GitHub account"; #4317, #4090, #4004, #3915 and #3914 merged with such commits and no approval, so that reason is not established.

## Owner decision
Question: the two stand-in comments on #4381. Answer: "Recommended: post one short comment on #4381 stating those two facts. I show you the exact text first." Source: owner's answer in the choice dialog, 2026-11-20.

## Change
Draft the comment in this item's context, show it to the owner, and post it only after the owner approves that text.

## Decision gates
Nothing is posted before the owner approves the exact text. The original comments are not edited or deleted.

## Verification rubric
Pass: the posted comment equals the approved text and its URL is recorded here.

## Guardrails (accepted by the owner, 2026-11-20)
The agent never posts a stand-in review, resolves a review thread, closes and reopens a pull request to restart CI, uses `--no-verify`, force-pushes, rewrites an author, or deletes anything under `~/Developer/benchmark_runs`. It arms with `make pr-arm` once per pull request and reports the result. Subagents are read-only. Any limit, default, threshold or label text is shown to the owner before it is committed. A blocked step stops this item; the agent moves to the next item and does not work around the block.
